description: Vertical 1080x1920 remotion kinetic scene. Dark background. Frame 0 bold immediate hook: huge fg=white text 'LOSE WITHOUT GETTING SICK?' at 18% from top (safe below top 10%). Focal center at 45% vertical: cluster of accent2 magenta-red spiky virus balls pulsing and scaling. At end a large accent=cyan glowing shield with lock icon slams from above to cover them. No captions zone violated.

beats.action: huge fg=white headline 'LOSE WITHOUT GETTING SICK?' pops in at upper-middle and single accent2 spiky virus ball pops in center
center virus splits fast 1 to 4 accent2 spiky copies scaling up with jitter
all viruses freeze mid-jitter, desaturate slightly, motion stops with freeze-frame ring
large accent=cyan glowing shield slams down from top over frozen viruses with shockwave and lock flash

description: Vertical remotion bloodstream scene in middle band 15-70%. Muted=grey pink wash vessel background. Four large soft fg=white blood cells drifting slowly left-right at 40-55% center. Small accent2 magenta-red spiky viruses on right-center that double. Pill counter 'DAY 1' in fg=white on dark at 15% from top center ticking to DAY 4. Small fg=white Y antibodies assembling slowly below center.

beats.action: bloodstream washes in, 4 fg=white blood cells drift slowly across mid-frame, DAY 1 pill appears top-center
cell drift drops to slow-motion crawl, clock icon pulses over cells
single small accent2 spiky virus fades in center-right pulsing
DAY counter ticks fast DAY 1 to DAY 4 while cells keep crawling
one tiny fg=white Y antibody assembles dot-by-dot below center, very slow
accent2 viruses double rapidly 1-2-4-8-16 filling right-center bouncing

description: Vertical remotion staged tutorial in center 20-70%. Background dark with vignette. Objects: single accent3=yellow 3-prong spike bobbing center; large muted=grey amoeba patrol cell left-center; large accent2=magenta glowing oval lymph node right-center; accent=cyan round B cells inside node; many small fg=white Y antibodies; final good=green glowing memory cells with MEMORY badges. Focus shifts left to right then to army then to survivors, one focal at a time.

beats.action: syringe icon slides in left-center and injects, 'SAFE PRACTICE ROUND' label pops in fg=white
single accent3 yellow spike floats in center bobbing alone
split-arrow duplicate icon over spike gets crossed by fg=white X and fades, spike stays one
muted=grey amoeba patrol cell slides in from left and engulfs yellow spike
patrol docks to accent2 magenta lymph node right-center and flashes yellow spike mugshot icon 3 times above it
single accent=cyan B cell inside node pops scale with wake-up ring
B cell clones to 12-cell accent=cyan army grid firing streams of fg=white Y antibodies outward that lock onto spike copies
9 of 12 clones turn muted=grey fade and sink down, Y streams stop
remaining 3 cells turn good=green glowing with MEMORY badge and resume slow patrol bob

description: Vertical remotion payoff, same bloodstream style for continuity. Center 30-65%: 3 dormant good=green memory cells dimly bobbing center-right; 6 accent2 magenta-red spiky viruses rush from left; dense fg=white Y antibodies flood; finale large accent=cyan shield with fg=white 'PROTECTED' text at 25% from top. SAVED GAME checkpoint banner at start.

beats.action: 'SAVED GAME' checkpoint banner pops top-center with 3 dim good=green memory cells sleeping center
6 accent2 spiky viruses rush fast left-to-center in arrow formation
memory cells flash bright good=green awake with expanding shockwave rings
awake cells spray dense flood of fg=white Y antibodies flying left to coat each virus
coated viruses shrivel to muted=grey puffs and dissolve, accent=cyan shield with PROTECTED slams in center
